entries.source: A smudged poem chalked on a dark piece of slate
entries.target: 一首写在石板上的被弄脏的诗歌

entries.source: Brilliantly white, but surrounded by blackest magic.
entries.target: 亮白色的牙齿，周身却萦绕着黑色的魔法。

entries.source: %s reduced the duration of this effect by %d turns, from %d to %d.
entries.target: %s将这一效果的持续时间降低%d回合，从%d回合降到%d回合。

entries.source: A length of troll intestines. Fortunately, the troll appears to have eaten nothing in some time.
entries.target: 一截巨魔肠子。幸运的是，这只巨魔碰巧没吃任何东西。

entries.source: Be close to the draconic world
Something in the floor clicks ominously.
entries.target: 什么东西在地上发出了不祥的咔嗒声。

entries.source: Flesh is falling off in chunks from this decaying abomination.
entries.target: 肉块正在不断的从这个腐朽的身体上掉落。

entries.source: You have no stat points left!
The heart of an orc. Perhaps surprisingly, it isn't green.
entries.target: 一颗兽人的心脏。很惊讶吧，它不是绿色的。

entries.source: You have %d generic talent point(s) to spend. Press p to use them.
entries.target: 你有 %d 通用技能点数，按下p来使用。
暴击时 奥术溅射伤害

entries.source: %s appears out of the thin air!
#AQUAMARINE#As #Source# falls you notice that #Target# seems to shudder in pain!
entries.target: #AQUAMARINE#当#Source#倒下时，你发现#Target#似乎因为痛苦而颤抖!

entries.source: Looks much like any other rock, though this one was recently sentient and trying to murder you.
entries.target: 它看起来和其他石头没什么两样，只不过这块不久前还具有意识，并且曾试图杀死你。

entries.source: a summoned, transparent wall of ice
entries.target: 被召唤来的一堵透明冰墙。
